accept.en: to agree to take or deal with
accept.ex: He accepted the job offer gladly.

acceptable.ex: Is it acceptable to arrive ten minutes late?

acclaimed.ex: The acclaimed director won another award last night.

example.en: Her critically acclaimed film won three awards.
example.zh: 她那部備受影評讚譽的電影贏得了三個獎項。

note.meaning: 備受讚譽的，受到評論家和大眾高度評價的。
note.usage: 常用 critically acclaimed / widely acclaimed 修飾作品或人物。

noteEn.meaning: praised a lot by critics and the public.

noteEs.exampleTr: Su película aclamada por la crítica ganó tres premios.
noteEs.meaning: muy elogiado por la crítica y el público.
noteEs.usage: Suele aparecer como critically acclaimed o widely acclaimed.

noteHi.exampleTr: उसकी समीक्षकों द्वारा प्रशंसित फ़िल्म ने तीन पुरस्कार जीते।
noteHi.meaning: जिसकी आलोचकों और लोगों ने बहुत प्रशंसा की हो।
noteHi.usage: critically acclaimed / widely acclaimed के रूप में अक्सर आता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 批評家に絶賛された彼女の映画は3つの賞を獲得した。
noteJa.meaning: 批評家や大衆から高く評価された。
noteJa.usage: critically acclaimed, widely acclaimed の形でよく使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 비평가들의 호평을 받은 그녀의 영화는 세 개의 상을 받았다.
noteKo.usage: critically acclaimed, widely acclaimed 형태로 자주 쓴다.

acknowledged.ex: The company acknowledged its mistake in a statement.

action.en: doing something; here part of a group's name
action.es: acción (en el nombre del grupo Palestine Action)
action.ex: The town took action to clean the river.
action.hi: कार्रवाई (समूह के नाम Palestine Action में)
action.ja: 行動（団体名 Palestine Action の一部）
action.zh: Palestine Action：巴勒斯坦行動（團體名）

agreed.ex: We all agreed with the plan.

agreement.ex: The plan went ahead with everyone's agreement.

alone.ex: This book alone sold ten thousand copies.

amount.en: amount to = be the same as

announced.ex: The school announced a new head teacher.

anti-terrorism.ex: New anti-terrorism rules were passed last year.

are.zh: 是；在（書名 Where Are You）

author's.ex: The author's new book comes out in May.

authors.ex: Many authors read their work at the festival.

backing.ex: Most voters are backing the new plan.

ban.ex: The city may ban cars from the centre.

banned.ex: The school banned phones in class.

bars.ex: The rule bars children from swimming alone.

bear.ex: She must bear the cost of the repairs.

beautiful.en: very nice to look at (in a book title)
beautiful.ex: They live in a beautiful old house.
beautiful.zh: 美麗的（書名 Beautiful World, Where Are You）

because.en: because of = for the reason of

beliefs.ex: People should respect each other's beliefs.

best-selling.ex: She is a best-selling crime writer.

blessing.ex: They married with their parents' blessing.

book.ex: I read a good book on the train.

books.ex: The library has thousands of books.

bookshops.ex: There are two bookshops on this street.

branded.ex: Critics branded the new law unfair.

called.ex: I have a dog called Max.

cannot.en: is not able or allowed to

cease.ex: The factory will cease production next year.

celebrated.ex: He is a celebrated chef from Paris.

column.ex: She writes a weekly column about food.

commercial.ex: The film was a big commercial hit.

commercially.ex: The product was not commercially successful.

consequence.en: a result of an action or event
consequence.ex: Losing his job was a consequence of his lateness.

example.en: Every choice we make has consequences.
example.zh: 我們做的每個選擇都有後果。

note.meaning: 某行動或事件所帶來的結果，常指不好的後果。
note.usage: 常用 accept/face/bear the consequences（承擔後果）；as a consequence 表示「因此」。

noteEn.meaning: a result of an action, often a bad one.
noteEn.usage: Common phrases: 'accept the consequences', 'a direct consequence of'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Cada decisión que tomamos tiene consecuencias.
noteEs.meaning: resultado de una acción, a menudo negativo.
noteEs.usage: Se usa en face/accept the consequences (asumir las consecuencias) y a direct consequence of.

noteHi.exampleTr: हमारे हर फ़ैसले के परिणाम होते हैं।
noteHi.meaning: किसी काम या घटना का परिणाम, अक्सर बुरा।
noteHi.usage: accept/face the consequences = परिणाम भुगतना; a direct consequence of = का सीधा परिणाम।

noteJa.exampleTr: 私たちの選択にはすべて結果が伴う。
noteJa.meaning: ある行動や出来事がもたらす結果（悪い結果が多い）。
noteJa.usage: face/accept the consequences で「結果を受け入れる」。a direct consequence of で「〜の直接の結果」。

noteKo.exampleTr: 우리가 하는 모든 선택에는 결과가 따른다.
noteKo.meaning: 어떤 행동이나 사건의 결과, 주로 나쁜 결과.
noteKo.usage: face/accept the consequences는 '결과를 감수하다', a direct consequence of는 '~의 직접적 결과'.

consequences.ex: Think about the consequences before you act.

example.en: Every choice we make has consequences.
example.zh: 我們做的每個選擇都有後果。

note.meaning: 某行動或事件所帶來的結果，常指不好的後果。
note.usage: 常用 accept/face/bear the consequences（承擔後果）；as a consequence 表示「因此」。

noteEn.meaning: a result of an action, often a bad one.
noteEn.usage: Common phrases: 'accept the consequences', 'a direct consequence of'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Cada decisión que tomamos tiene consecuencias.
noteEs.meaning: resultado de una acción, a menudo negativo.
noteEs.usage: Se usa en face/accept the consequences (asumir las consecuencias) y a direct consequence of.

noteHi.exampleTr: हमारे हर फ़ैसले के परिणाम होते हैं।
noteHi.meaning: किसी काम या घटना का परिणाम, अक्सर बुरा।
noteHi.usage: accept/face the consequences = परिणाम भुगतना; a direct consequence of = का सीधा परिणाम।

noteJa.exampleTr: 私たちの選択にはすべて結果が伴う。
noteJa.meaning: ある行動や出来事がもたらす結果（悪い結果が多い）。
noteJa.usage: face/accept the consequences で「結果を受け入れる」。a direct consequence of で「〜の直接の結果」。

noteKo.exampleTr: 우리가 하는 모든 선택에는 결과가 따른다.
noteKo.meaning: 어떤 행동이나 사건의 결과, 주로 나쁜 결과.
noteKo.usage: face/accept the consequences는 '결과를 감수하다', a direct consequence of는 '~의 직접적 결과'.

consequently.ex: It rained; consequently, the match was cancelled.

considers.en: thinks of something in a certain way
considers.ex: She considers the plan too risky.

constitute.ex: This delay could constitute a breach of contract.

example.en: Lying to the police may constitute a crime.
example.zh: 對警察說謊可能構成犯罪。

note.meaning: 構成；（在法律或正式場合）等同於、算是。
note.usage: 正式用語，常見 constitute an offence / a threat / a breach，意思是「構成…」。

noteEn.meaning: to be or count as something, often in law.
noteEn.usage: Formal; common in 'constitute an offence' or 'constitute a threat'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Mentir a la policía puede constituir un delito.
noteEs.meaning: ser o equivaler a algo, sobre todo en sentido legal.
noteEs.usage: Es formal: constitute an offence (constituir un delito), constitute a threat.

noteHi.exampleTr: पुलिस से झूठ बोलना अपराध माना जा सकता है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ के बराबर माना जाना; बनाना।
noteHi.usage: औपचारिक शब्द; constitute an offence = अपराध माना जाना।

noteJa.exampleTr: 警察にうそをつくことは犯罪に当たる可能性がある。
noteJa.usage: 硬い語。constitute an offence（犯罪に当たる）、constitute a threat などで使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 경찰에게 거짓말하는 것은 범죄에 해당할 수 있다.
noteKo.usage: 격식 있는 말로 constitute an offence(범죄에 해당하다) 등으로 쓴다.

continue.ex: Please continue reading after the break.

continuing.ex: She is continuing her studies abroad.

contracts.ex: The players signed new contracts yesterday.

conversations.en: talks between people (in a book title)
conversations.ex: We had long conversations about music.
conversations.zh: 對話（書名 Conversations with Friends）

copies.en: single books of the same title
copies.ex: The magazine sells two million copies a week.

current.ex: The current rules are too strict.

dangerous.ex: This road is dangerous at night.

decision.ex: It was a hard decision to leave.

declared.ex: He declared that he would run for mayor.

describing.ex: She sent a letter describing her trip.

designation.en: official naming of something as a certain type
designation.ex: The area's designation as a park protects it.

example.en: The forest's designation as a national park was welcomed.
example.zh: 這片森林被指定為國家公園，受到歡迎。

note.meaning: 正式指定、認定為某種類別或名稱。
note.usage: 常用 designation as…（被認定為…）；多見於法律、政府公告。

noteEn.meaning: officially naming something as a certain type.
noteEn.usage: Often 'designation as …' in legal or official language.

noteEs.exampleTr: La designación del bosque como parque nacional fue bien recibida.
noteEs.meaning: acto de nombrar o clasificar algo oficialmente.
noteEs.usage: Se usa designation as…; típico del lenguaje legal y oficial.

noteHi.exampleTr: जंगल को राष्ट्रीय उद्यान घोषित किए जाने का स्वागत हुआ।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ को आधिकारिक रूप से किसी श्रेणी में घोषित करना।
noteHi.usage: designation as … आम है; सरकारी और क़ानूनी भाषा में।

noteJa.exampleTr: その森が国立公園に指定されたことは歓迎された。
noteJa.meaning: 公式にある分類・名称に指定すること。
noteJa.usage: designation as 〜（〜としての指定）の形で、法律・行政の文脈で使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 숲이 국립공원으로 지정된 것은 환영받았다.
noteKo.meaning: 어떤 범주나 명칭으로 공식 지정하는 것.
noteKo.usage: designation as ~ 형태로 법률·행정 문맥에서 쓴다.

development.ex: This is an important development in the case.

direct.ex: The flood was a direct result of the storm.

direct-action.en: using protests and actions, not just talk
direct-action.ex: A direct-action group blocked the road.

discontinue.ex: The shop will discontinue this model next month.

earns.ex: She earns good money as a nurse.

emphasised.en: said strongly that something is important
emphasised.ex: The coach emphasised the need for teamwork.

ethically.en: in terms of right and wrong
ethically.ex: Is it ethically right to test on animals?

excess.ex: Prices rose in excess of ten percent.

explained.ex: The teacher explained the rules again.

famous.ex: Paris is famous for its food.

follows.ex: The strike follows weeks of failed talks.

for.zh: for her part：就她而言；為了

form.ex: The book is also available in digital form.

format.en: the way something is produced, e.g. print
format.ex: The album is out in CD format.

formats.en: ways something is produced, e.g. print or audio
formats.ex: The novel is sold in three formats.

formidable.ex: She is a formidable opponent at chess.

example.en: The team faces a formidable challenge this season.
example.zh: 這支球隊本季面臨艱鉅的挑戰。

note.meaning: 強大的、令人敬畏的；實力或規模驚人。
note.usage: 可形容對手、人物或能力，如 a formidable opponent / reputation；帶有「不好對付」的意味。

noteEn.meaning: very strong, impressive and hard to beat.

noteEs.exampleTr: El equipo se enfrenta a un desafío formidable esta temporada.
noteEs.meaning: muy fuerte e impresionante, que inspira respeto.
noteEs.usage: Se usa en a formidable opponent / reputation; sugiere algo difícil de superar.

noteHi.exampleTr: इस सीज़न टीम के सामने एक ज़बरदस्त चुनौती है।
noteHi.meaning: बहुत शक्तिशाली और प्रभावशाली, जिससे सम्मान या डर पैदा हो।
noteHi.usage: a formidable opponent / reputation जैसे प्रयोग आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: そのチームは今季手ごわい課題に直面している。
noteJa.meaning: 非常に強力で、畏敬の念を抱かせる。
noteJa.usage: a formidable opponent / reputation などで使い、「手ごわい」含みがある。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 팀은 이번 시즌 만만치 않은 도전에 직면해 있다.
noteKo.usage: a formidable opponent / reputation 등으로 쓰며 '상대하기 어려운' 뉘앙스가 있다.

friends.en: people you know and like (in a book title)
friends.ex: I met my friends at the park.
friends.zh: 朋友（書名 Conversations with Friends）

fulfilling.ex: Fulfilling the order took two weeks.

government's.ex: The government's plan was announced today.

group.ex: She joined a local walking group.

have.en: cause something to be done; form of 'have'

honest.ex: Please give me an honest answer.

honouring.ex: The firm is honouring all its old orders.

illegal.ex: It is illegal to drive without a licence.

indefensible.hi: अनुचित; जिसका बचाव न हो सके

example.en: Cutting the nurses' pay was indefensible.
example.zh: 削減護理師的薪水是說不過去的。

note.meaning: 無法辯護的；站不住腳、不能被合理化的。
note.usage: 常形容行為或決定在道德上無理，如 morally/ethically indefensible。

noteEs.exampleTr: Recortar el sueldo de las enfermeras era indefendible.
noteEs.meaning: que no se puede justificar ni defender.
noteEs.usage: Se usa para acciones moralmente injustificables: morally/ethically indefensible.

noteHi.exampleTr: नर्सों का वेतन घटाना बिल्कुल अनुचित था।
noteHi.meaning: जिसका बचाव या जिसे उचित न ठहराया जा सके।
noteHi.usage: अक्सर नैतिक रूप से ग़लत कामों के लिए: morally/ethically indefensible।

noteJa.exampleTr: 看護師の給料を削ることは弁護の余地がなかった。
noteJa.meaning: 弁護・正当化できない。
noteJa.usage: 倫理的に許されない行為に使う：morally/ethically indefensible。

noteKo.exampleTr: 간호사 임금을 삭감한 것은 정당화할 수 없었다.
noteKo.usage: 도덕적으로 잘못된 행동에 쓰며 morally/ethically indefensible이 흔하다.

indefensible.zh: 站不住腳的；無法辯護的

intended.ex: I intended to call you yesterday.

intention.ex: He has no intention of leaving.

irish.zh: 愛爾蘭的；The Irish Times：《愛爾蘭時報》

law.ex: Wearing a seat belt is the law.

laws.ex: Each country has its own laws.

example.en: The government plans to pass new legislation on housing.
example.zh: 政府計畫通過新的住房法律。

note.meaning: 由政府或議會制定的法律（總稱）。
note.usage: 為不可數名詞，不說 a legislation；可說 a piece of legislation。常見 introduce/pass legislation。

noteEn.meaning: laws made by a government or parliament.
noteEn.usage: It is uncountable: say 'a piece of legislation', not 'a legislation'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El gobierno planea aprobar nueva legislación sobre vivienda.
noteEs.meaning: leyes aprobadas por un gobierno o parlamento.
noteEs.usage: Es incontable: no se dice 'a legislation'; se dice 'a piece of legislation'. Común: pass legislation.

noteHi.exampleTr: सरकार आवास पर नया क़ानून पारित करने की योजना बना रही है।
noteHi.meaning: सरकार या संसद द्वारा बनाए गए क़ानून।
noteHi.usage: यह अगणनीय संज्ञा है; a piece of legislation कहते हैं। pass legislation = क़ानून पारित करना।

noteJa.exampleTr: 政府は住宅に関する新しい法律を成立させる予定だ。
noteJa.meaning: 政府や議会が定めた法律（総称）。
noteJa.usage: 不可算名詞なので a legislation とは言わない。a piece of legislation, pass legislation が一般的。

noteKo.exampleTr: 정부는 주택에 관한 새 법률을 통과시킬 계획이다.
noteKo.usage: 불가산 명사라 a legislation이라고 하지 않고 a piece of legislation이라고 한다. pass legislation이 흔하다.

linked.ex: The illness is linked to poor diet.

made.ex: The rain made the roads dangerous.

markets.en: places or countries where things are sold
markets.ex: The company sells to markets in Asia.

meant.ex: The snow meant the school closed.

money.en: coins and notes used to buy things
money.ex: I saved money for a new bike.

most.ex: She is the most careful driver I know.

move.en: an action taken to get a result
move.ex: Closing the shop was a smart move.

nevertheless.ex: It was cold; nevertheless, we went swimming.

newspaper.ex: My dad reads the newspaper every morning.

normal.ex: It's normal to feel nervous before a test.
normal.zh: Normal People：《正常人》（書名）；正常的

not.ex: She is not at home today.

notion.ex: The notion of working from home is popular.

novel.ex: Her first novel became a film.

novelists.ex: Many young novelists live in Dublin.

novels.ex: He reads two novels a month.

offence.ex: Driving drunk is a serious offence.

on.en: used in 'pass on' = give to someone else
on.ex: Please pass the message on to your sister.

one.en: the number 1; one of a group

opinion.ex: In my opinion, the film was too long.

organisation.ex: She works for a charity organisation.

outcome.ex: We are waiting for the outcome of the vote.

palestine.en: part of the group name Palestine Action
palestine.zh: 巴勒斯坦；Palestine Action：巴勒斯坦行動（團體名）

part.en: for her part = speaking for herself
part.ex: For my part, I agree with the plan.

pass.ex: Please pass on my thanks to your mum.

passed.ex: The video passed a million views.

people.ex: Many people came to the party.

piece.en: a piece of writing; an article
piece.ex: He wrote a short piece for the school paper.

prepared.ex: Are you prepared to work weekends?

prevents.ex: The rain prevents us from playing.

prohibited.ex: Smoking is prohibited in the building.

proscribed.ex: The party was proscribed after the war.

example.en: The government proscribed the group last year.
example.zh: 政府去年依法取締了該團體。

note.meaning: （政府）以法律正式禁止某團體或行為。
note.usage: 語氣正式，多用於法律、政治新聞；常見被動 be proscribed as a terrorist organisation。

noteEn.meaning: to officially ban a group or activity by law.
noteEn.usage: It is formal; often passive: 'be proscribed as a terrorist group'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El gobierno ilegalizó el grupo el año pasado.
noteEs.meaning: prohibir oficialmente por ley un grupo o actividad.
noteEs.usage: Es formal y se usa en noticias legales y políticas; a menudo en pasiva: be proscribed as.

noteHi.exampleTr: सरकार ने पिछले साल उस समूह पर प्रतिबंध लगा दिया।
noteHi.meaning: सरकार द्वारा क़ानूनन किसी समूह या काम पर प्रतिबंध लगाना।
noteHi.usage: यह औपचारिक शब्द है; अक्सर कर्मवाच्य में: be proscribed as a terrorist organisation।

noteJa.exampleTr: 政府は昨年その団体を非合法化した。
noteJa.meaning: 政府が法律で団体や行為を正式に禁止する。
noteJa.usage: 硬い語で、法律・政治の報道で使う。受動態 be proscribed as 〜 が多い。

noteKo.meaning: 정부가 법으로 단체나 행위를 공식 금지하다.
noteKo.usage: 격식 있는 말로 법률·정치 기사에 쓰이며, 수동태 be proscribed as가 흔하다.

proscription.ex: The proscription of the group surprised many.

prospect.en: the idea of a possible future event
prospect.ex: The prospect of moving abroad scared her.

protest.ex: Thousands joined the protest in the square.

publication.en: making a book available to the public

publish.ex: They publish ten books a year.

published.ex: Her poems were published last spring.

publisher.en: company that makes and sells books
publisher.ex: The publisher loved her first book.

publishing.ex: He is publishing a book about cats.

reached.ex: The jury reached a decision quickly.

remains.ex: The shop remains open until nine.

remitting.ex: Workers abroad are remitting money to their families.

republic.en: a country with no king; here Ireland
republic.ex: France became a republic long ago.

royalties.en: money paid to a writer for each book sold
royalties.ex: The singer earns royalties from every song.

sale.ex: The sale of alcohol is limited here.

sell.ex: They sell fresh bread every morning.

selling.ex: She is selling her old car.

send.en: to make money go to someone
send.ex: Can you send me the money today?

serious.ex: There was a serious accident on the road.

shifted.ex: The shop shifted all its stock in a week.

significant.ex: This is a significant change in the law.

so.ex: He asked me to wait, and I did so.

sold.ex: The shop sold out of milk.

stated.ex: The report stated that prices would rise.

statement.ex: The club released a statement this morning.

stature.ex: Her stature as a scientist keeps growing.

example.en: Few politicians have his stature abroad.
example.zh: 很少有政治人物在國外享有他那樣的聲望。

note.meaning: （因成就而來的）聲望、地位；也可指身高。
note.usage: 常見 of international stature、grow in stature；文中指作家的地位。

noteEn.meaning: the importance and respect someone has earned.

noteEs.exampleTr: Pocos políticos tienen su prestigio en el extranjero.
noteEs.meaning: prestigio o importancia que alguien ha ganado.
noteEs.usage: Común: of international stature, grow in stature.

noteHi.exampleTr: विदेश में बहुत कम नेताओं की उसके जैसी प्रतिष्ठा है।

paragraphs: Sally Rooney is a famous writer from Ireland. Her books sell very well. Her book Normal People sold more than one million copies in the UK.
Now her publisher, Faber & Faber, will stop selling her books in the UK. It will still sell them in other countries.
Why? In 2025, the UK government banned a protest group called Palestine Action. It said the group was dangerous. Rooney said she would still support the group. It is not banned in Ireland.
Because of UK law, Faber cannot pay her money from UK sales. Faber says it is wrong to sell her books and not pay her. Rooney agreed with the decision.

The Irish writer Sally Rooney will no longer have her books published in the UK. Her publisher, Faber & Faber, says it will stop selling her work there in any form, but it will continue to publish her in other countries.
Rooney is one of Ireland's most successful authors. Her novel Normal People has sold more than one million copies in the UK, and two of her other novels have each sold more than half a million.

The decision is linked to Palestine Action, a protest group. In July 2025, the UK government made the group illegal under its terrorism laws. The next month, Rooney wrote in The Irish Times that she would continue to support it. The group is not banned in Ireland.
Faber says that, under UK law, it cannot send her the money she earns from UK sales. It says selling a writer's books without paying her is not acceptable.
Rooney said the decision was made with her full agreement. She said she had tried to be honest about her beliefs and was ready to accept what happens.
Faber & Faber will stop publishing Sally Rooney's books in the UK in any format, the publisher has announced, although it will continue to sell her work in other markets.

Rooney is among Ireland's best-selling and most celebrated novelists. Normal People has sold over a million copies in the UK alone, while Conversations with Friends and Beautiful World, Where Are You have each passed 500,000.

The move follows the UK's decision in July 2025 to ban Palestine Action, a direct-action protest group, as a terrorist organisation. A month later, Rooney stated in an opinion piece that she intended to keep supporting the group, which is not prohibited in the Republic.
Faber said current UK anti-terrorism legislation meant it could not pass on her UK earnings, describing the prospect of selling an author's work without paying her as unacceptable.

In a statement, Rooney said that fulfilling her UK contracts could now amount to a serious criminal offence, and that the decision had been taken with her full agreement. She said she was prepared to accept the consequences of her beliefs.
Sally Rooney's novels will vanish from British bookshops after Faber & Faber announced it would cease publishing her work in the UK in any format, while continuing to do so elsewhere.

The move is a striking one, given Rooney's stature as one of Ireland's most acclaimed and commercially formidable writers: Normal People alone has shifted more than a million copies in the UK, and two further novels have each surpassed half a million.

The decision stems from the UK's proscription of Palestine Action as a terrorist organisation in July 2025. Weeks later, Rooney declared in a newspaper column that she would persist in backing the direct-action group, which remains lawful in the Republic.
Faber explained that British counter-terrorism legislation bars it from remitting her UK royalties, and branded the notion of selling a writer's books while withholding her earnings untenable.

Rooney, for her part, said honouring her UK contracts might now constitute a grave criminal offence. She stressed that the outcome had her full blessing and that she was willing to bear the consequences of her convictions.
